response.justification: MOC-2012-0023 was raised at Cape Verity Export Terminal on 4 April 2012 as a scheduled change under change request; no event precedes it in the record. The change request record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the critical safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2014-0087, PRO-MEC-041, PRO-OPS-017 and PTW-STD-003.
